deck.text_normalisation: CRLF/CR -> LF; control characters other than LF and TAB dropped; Unicode NFC; CJK radicals (U+2E80-U+2FDF) -> NFKC (e.g. U+2F47 -> U+65E5); trailing spaces of each line and blank lines at both ends removed

execution.converter: LibreOffice soffice for pptx / ppt / key / odp (argv only, a fresh temporary profile, run on a copy of the deck)
execution.engine: ffmpeg-skill (scripts run with this Python, argv only)
execution.overwrites: never unless --overwrite; -o equal to the input is refused

insert.shift: every segment after an insertion moves later by the clip's measured duration

match.unmatched: page null with reason below_min_score or ambiguous

not_provided: slide text from images or scanned pages (OCR: detection-skill)
matching by slide text (OCR of the frames is detection-skill's; match compares pictures)
running ffmpeg or ffprobe directly (only through ffmpeg-skill)
editing the picture or cutting the talk beyond splicing clips in at slide boundaries (video-editing-skill)

tools.description: Slide changes of a talk recording: one entry per slide (start, end, duration), from ffmpeg-skill scenes
Chapters from a slide timeline: chapter text (YouTube description format) and, with -o, a copy of the video carrying them as container chapters (ffmpeg-skill metadata, streams copied)

Slide deck to one PNG and one text per page plus a deck.json manifest (slide-sync/deck@1). PDF through pypdfium2 (optional extra 'pdf'); pptx / ppt / key / odp converted to PDF by LibreOffice when installed

Which page of an imported deck is on screen in each slide of a timeline (slide-sync/match@1): page, confidence and margin per segment by image correlation of frames (ffmpeg-skill look) with the page images, or page null with the reason when no page is clearly best. Order need not follow the deck

Splice clips into a recording at slide boundaries (a demo video as it is, an image as a still clip): ffmpeg-skill probe / insert / cut --accurate / join --transition none, then the shifted timeline's chapters through metadata. Every slide after an insertion moves later by the clip's measured length; the timeline (provenance DERIVED) records each edit
